name: io.github.snapdeploy/mcp
description: Deploy and manage SnapDeploy containers from your AI assistant — GitHub deploys, logs, env vars, add-ons, domains. No delete capability by design; secrets never exposed.

environment_variables.name: SNAPDEPLOY_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Scoped personal access token (sd_pat_…) from https://snapdeploy.dev/api-keys

environment_variables.name: SNAPDEPLOY_READ_ONLY
environment_variables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read tools
